gaps.description: Symbol presence and manually closed statuses do not establish behavioral equivalence; the second audit reproduces additional divergences against C++ 5.3.5.14.
gaps.pass_criteria: All open audit contract probes must pass as ordinary release tests; inventory completeness alone is insufficient.

gaps.description: Composite/FIX/NVFIX and header/message parsing paths handle invalid ranges and malformed wire data without panics.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes parser/builder coverage tests.

gaps.description: LogonParams.Timeout is enforced during logon ack wait.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... includes logon-timeout coverage and passes.

gaps.description: tcp/tcps URI compression=zlib and Client.SetCompression(true) enable compressed transport for regular and HA clients while rejecting unsupported transports.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes transport compression coverage and parity docs describe the tcp/tcps-only contract.

gaps.description: File-backed stores use append/checkpoint persistence with crash-safe recovery semantics.
gaps.pass_criteria: Normal-suite persistence tests include torn-tail recovery followed by append and another restart, plus unambiguous acceptance after checkpoint failure (D02/D03).

gaps.description: Recovery ordering is deterministic: publish replay, resubscribe, retry/deferred callbacks.
gaps.pass_criteria: Ordinary tests also prove live publishes cannot overtake recovery and unsubscribe cannot be undone by an older recovery snapshot (D01/D10).

gaps.description: A disconnect after recovery succeeds but before its worker releases ownership triggers another recovery.
gaps.pass_criteria: TestIntegrationHAReconnectAfterDisconnectAtSuccess passes with race detection, including forced disconnect during ReportSuccess.

gaps.description: A received processed ack stops its warning; a completed watcher cannot follow a replacement command, and fakeamps flushes acknowledgements before later queued data.
gaps.pass_criteria: The ack warning lifecycle regressions, TestConnWriterFlushesAcknowledgementBeforeQueuedData, FIFO/coalescing regressions and the expanded stress gate pass without increasing the 250ms warning threshold.

gaps.description: Pure-Go Kerberos compatibility authenticator is available through a dedicated package and existing Authenticator contract.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes kerberos package tests.

gaps.description: CAPI SSL compatibility has stateful handle/context validation and deterministic error behavior.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/capi passes SSL compatibility tests.

gaps.description: Benchmark baseline and regression gate are available for hot-path operations.
gaps.pass_criteria: go run ./tools/perfgate validates benchmark deltas within threshold.

gaps.description: Parity acceptance and scope docs align with implemented behavior and gate commands.
gaps.pass_criteria: docs include gap register and parity acceptance workflow referencing machine gates.

gaps.description: CRC es otro algoritmo
gaps.pass_criteria: C++ 5.3.5.14 contract probes pass without disabling the behavior: TestParityAuditCRCMatchesCPP.

gaps.pass_criteria: C++ 5.3.5.14 contract probes pass without disabling the behavior: TestParityAuditHybridSequencesRemainUniqueOnFallback.

gaps.description: Una publicación concurrente adelanta al replay y su ack acumulativo elimina mensajes todavía no enviados.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditLivePublishCannotOvertakeRecovery and TestDeepAuditIntegrationLivePublishDuringReplayLosesBacklog without weakening order/count assertions. Also cover SOWDelete, publication from LoggedOn after installing the server sequence floor, and recovery generation changes.

gaps.description: Una cola parcial ignorada al recuperar el WAL corrompe la siguiente escritura y el segundo reinicio.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditPublishWALTornTailThenAppendThenRestart and TestDeepAuditBookmarkWALTornTailThenAppendThenRestart, preserving exact retained state.

gaps.description: Publish devuelve error después de que el WAL retuvo el mensaje, induciendo reintentos ambiguos.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditPublishCheckpointFailureIsNotRejectedAfterRetention, covering errors both before and after durable acceptance. Checkpoint-only rejection must roll back; uncertain WAL rollback must preserve the cause and block later mutations/checkpoints.

gaps.description: HybridPublishStore reemplaza el piso de secuencia de sus backends nuevos por un ack antiguo.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditFreshHybridDoesNotReuseOldPublisherSequences; preserve monotonicity across fresh/reopened stores and fallback.

gaps.description: Los headers conservan escapes JSON y el sub_id decodificado no encuentra su ruta.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditReceivedHeaderUnescapesText and TestDeepAuditEscapedSubscriptionIDRoutes for both fast and checked parsers; keep current perf limits.

gaps.description: HAClient.SetTimeout no limita el logon cuando el servidor acepta TCP y no responde.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditHATimeoutIncludesLogon without increasing its 40ms setting or 300ms observation window; test successful logon and cancellation too. The same budget and cancellation cover HTTP preflight and recovery acknowledgements without closing a newer generation. Terminal failure must stop independent reconnects and late callbacks; successful recovery must hand off subsequent disconnects. Stale queued attempts and workers must preserve a newer session, including reentrant reconnect listeners.

gaps.description: Los getters de versión y name hash compiten con escrituras del logon.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote TestDeepAuditLogonMetadataConcurrentReaders and pass it with -race; assert coherent metadata across logon transitions.

gaps.description: fakeamps olvida la secuencia del publisher al cerrar la conexión y aplica otra vez un replay idéntico.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditFakePublisherDedupSurvivesReconnect; retain separate identities and persistence semantics, and correct the contradictory existing test. Disk reload restores publisher identity and sequence; torn tails are repaired before append, malformed complete records and unavailable/uncertain storage reject writes.

gaps.description: El store copia el comando antes de agregar persisted, por lo que el replay no solicita su confirmación.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass all six TestDeepAuditReplayPreservesPersistedAck cases; verify recovery-only traffic drains on persisted acknowledgements. Legacy memory, WAL and checkpoint backlog also requests persisted after upgrade without changing sequence, payload, requested acknowledgements or a custom store's original command.

gaps.description: Un snapshot de recuperación puede recrear una suscripción después de que Unsubscribe terminó.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditUnsubscribeDuringRecoveryIsNotResurrected, asserting final wire order and route removal.

gaps.description: HasNext olvida el mensaje previo cuando falla su ack y la siguiente llamada avanza.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditStreamAckFailureCannotBeBypassedByNextCall, then prove successful retry preserves each delivery. Explicit disconnect preserves pending acknowledgements and recovery flushes them without new traffic.

gaps.description: ExecuteAsync desconectado retiene el publish pero no su callback de acknowledgements.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditOfflineExecutePreservesAckHandler; retain requested-ack filtering and route cleanup.

gaps.description: Un error del handler de cola deja el lease activo en vez de cancelarlo como C++.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditFailedQueueHandlerCancelsLease; cover ignore-auto-ack and cancellation send failures.

gaps.description: Message.Ack envía otra confirmación cuando AutoAck está habilitado, a diferencia de C++.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditMessageAckDefersToAutoAck; retain manual Ack behavior when AutoAck is disabled.

gaps.description: JSONMessageBuilder usa escapes de literales Go que producen JSON inválido para 27 controles ASCII.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass TestDeepAuditJSONBuilderProducesValidJSONForControls; cover keys, values, quotes, backslashes and Unicode without changing perf limits.

gaps.description: fakeamps descarta publicaciones distintas que comparten command ID.
gaps.pass_criteria: Promote and pass both TestDeepAuditFakeCommandIDIsNotPublishIdentity cases; preserve deduplication by publisher identity and sequence. Distinct SOW deletes may also share a command ID; sequence-based replay cannot delete a newly inserted row.

gaps.description: The official C++ client consumes fakeamps live route lists, escaped topics, and EPOCH/NOW/explicit bookmark replay.
gaps.pass_criteria: make cpp-integration passes live and all three bookmark scenarios; ordinary CPP routing/bookmark regressions and bounded formal checks pass.

gaps.description: The official C++ client can ack queue deliveries, receive lease redelivery with one or competing consumers, retain publishes through reconnect, and receive explicitly enabled OOF.
gaps.pass_criteria: make cpp-integration passes queue-ack, queue-lease, queue-single-lease, retained-reconnect and oof; ordinary queue and OOF regressions pass.
